title: Nutrient-rich Turkish Lamb Tagine
description: A comforting and nutritious dish featuring tender lamb, tangy buttermilk, and a sweet lacquer glaze, all within a Whole30-friendly recipe.
instructions: Rinse the lamb shoulder and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the lamb with salt, black pepper, and cumin.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the diced onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the buttermilk to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise the lamb for 2 hours, or until tender.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside to rest.
Skim the fat from the surface of the sauce and stir in the sugar and lacquer glaze.
Serve the lamb with the sauce spooned over the top and garnished with fresh parsley.
